# Test fixtures

Every fixture in this directory is **synthetic**. The `qaa` language code marks invented text, not a real language. Real ScriptureEarth bytes are never committed here (M2-PLAN §8).

- `qaa_sample.usfm`: exercises the WP2.4 USFM marker table (headings, verses with parts, notes, cross-references, character markers, attributes, nested markers, `~`, `//`, an omitted verse, an unknown marker, NFD text and a second chapter).
